title: H.264 self-contained IDR suffix

definition.title: H.264 self-contained IDR suffix
definition.source_excerpt: The raw 6-second 30-fps AVC stream has 180 packets and IDRs at packet indexes 0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150. x264 repeated SPS/PPS at IDRs. Starting the byte stream directly at packet 60 produces 120 decoded frames whose YUV420 bytes are exactly equal to frames 60–179 of the continuous decode. The retained coded suffix is 143,452/208,538 bytes (68.8%). This supports a qualified minimal-byte seek route for Annex-B AVC when the chosen random-access point carries everything the decoder needs.
